fields.name: 🌺 Patio Flower Count & Botanical Vision Feed

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.yellow_flowers') AS INTEGER) AS yellow, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.orange_light_flowers') AS INTEGER) AS orange_light, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.orange_dark_flowers') AS INTEGER) AS orange_dark, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.total_flowers') AS INTEGER) AS total_flowers, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.analysis_summary') AS vision_summary FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'CountFlowersByColor' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20

view.title: Patio Flower Count Distribution by Color

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS audit_time, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.model_id') AS model, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.audit_status') AS status, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.avg_latency_ms') AS INTEGER) AS latency_ms, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.efficiency_summary') AS summary FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'AIExecutionCognivityAuditory' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20
